descriptionText: Detects Actions workflows executing untrusted PR head code in a privileged context via: (A) pull_request_target with tainted checkout ref (head.ref, refs/pull/*/merge, or head.sha); (B) pull_request_target with direct expression injection of pull_request.head.ref in a run script; (C) issue_comment fetching/checking out PR head code without an author_association guard.
